title: Primordial spectra from modified Bekenstein-Hawking entropy law
summary: Many approaches to quantum gravity predict logarithmic corrections to the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy. Within the spacetime-thermodynamic description of gravity, such corrections lead to modified gravitational field equations. We study their effect on primordial perturbations during standard single-field slow-roll inflation. We derive the evolution equation for the comoving curvature perturbation and show that it retains the standard Mukhanov--Sasaki form, with the quantum-gravity correction entering through the time-dependent effective frequency.
